canonical: Sort object keys recursively; finite numbers rounded to 6 decimal places; integral floats become integers; compact UTF-8 JSON. No generated timestamps or generator fields in pure scoring results.

limitations: Self-assessment, not a certification or legal advice.
Maturity bands require at least 80% response coverage.

readiness.rules: Question IDs dimension-1 through dimension-5. All six dimensions always returned, in listed order. Missing dimension score null. Empty overall null. Override weights merge with defaults then normalise; nonnegative finite values, sum > 0. Gaps score <= 2 ordered descending priority then questionId; priority=weight*(5-score). Gap {questionId,dimensionId,score,priority,recommendation}; recommendations map gaps to {questionId,action}. Exact text in readiness-framework.v1.json.

roi.rules: month 0 build cost excluded monthlyCashFlow but included NPV/cumulative/ROI denominator. Month n adoption=min(1,n/adoptionMonths), or 1 if adoptionMonths=0. hours=users*volume*minutes*savings/60*adoption. potentialValue=hours*hourlyCost; cashBenefit=potentialValue*cashRealisation. runCost=monthlyRunCost (full from month1). net=cashBenefit-runCost. NPV=-buildCost+sum(net/(1+annualDiscountRate)^(month/12)). payback first month cumulative >=0; zero build cost returns 0 only when the first monthly net cash flow is nonnegative; otherwise payback is the first later month cumulative cash flow recovers to >=0, or null. ROI=(totalCashBenefit-buildCost-totalRunCost)/(buildCost+totalRunCost)*100 or null denominator0. costPerTask=(buildCost+runCostTotal)/(users*volume*horizon) or null. breakEvenAdoption=monthlyRunCost/(fullPotentialMonthly*cashRealisation) or null (can >1). recoveredCapacityHours=totalHoursSaved*(1-cashRealisation). topDrivers exactly [{name:'time-saving fraction',value:savings.base},{name:'cash-realisation fraction',value:cashRealisation},{name:'monthly task volume',value:users*tasksPerUserPerMonth}]. Round only output, calculate intermediate full precision.

delivery.input: computeMetrics(events, {since,until,productionEnvironment?:'production'}). Dates ISO8601 including timezone required. Metric period half-open [since,until). Events union documented in delivery-events.schema.json.
delivery.rules: Exact algorithms and null cases in packages/delivery-metrics/src/index.ts. scoreDeliveryHealth returns {status:'informational',metrics:report.metrics,actions:[string],limitations:[string]}; no composite score or invented industry thresholds. Python may implement same exact event model. See source/vectors before parity.
